item.title: Iligal rubbish duping, 22nd August
item.description:
Dear Camden Council, I would like to report a large amount of non-household rubbish that has been dumped on the pavement and roadside, as shown in the attached photograph. The waste includes black bags, cardboard, furniture/building materials and other bulky items. It is obstructing the pavement and making the area look untidy, as well as potentially creating a hazard for pedestrians. Please could you arrange for this rubbish to be removed and investigate the fly-tipping if possible? I have attached a photograph showing the waste and the location. Kind regards, Ivonn Pokrzywka

Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: New restaurant leaving rubbish in the street, 22nd August
item.description:
Since the Bur+ by Owenese restaurant opened on the corner of Gainsford Street and Curlew Street there has been rubbish dumped both on Gainsford Street (recycle rubbish) outside the restaurant and opposite the restaurant on Curlew Street (food rubbish). Sometimes it is there for days before being collected. Today, there is so much it is partly blocking the footpath on Gainsford Street. Some of the rubbish has labels on it which identify the restaurant (see photo).

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 57A, Gainsford Street, Bermondsey, Greater London
